name: harness-co
description: Development entrypoint for the Harness Company stack (backend, web).

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && exec .venv/bin/uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8400} --use-colors
scripts.dev:web: FORCE_COLOR=1 exec npm --prefix web run dev -- --port ${WEB_PORT:-3000}
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w engine/compose -w engine/cli -w engine/definitions
scripts.sheet: npm run build -w engine/cli && npm --prefix web run sheet
scripts.build: npm run build -w engine/compose -w engine/cli -w engine/definitions && (cd pi && npm run build:offline) && (cd web && npm run build)
scripts.test: npm run test -w engine/compose -w engine/cli -w engine/definitions && (cd pi && npm test) && (cd web && npm test --if-present)
